authority: 研究者明确：tokens仅供研究用，实际部署时用户等待的延迟才是目标。
supersedes_in_RL1: Original September 28 scope that optimized resource input tokens while relegating latency to reporting or a future extension.

latency_measurements.start: client send before any method-specific PM, encoding, retrieval or planning
latency_measurements.TTFT_end: first nonempty actual reply text visible or received at the declared client surface
latency_measurements.completion_end: complete natural-end response visible or received at the same surface
latency_measurements.clock: same client monotonic clock for start and both endpoints

included_online_work: G prefill and full natural decoding

comparison.incomplete_calls: retain observed wait and failure/censoring status; never relabel as completed or silently drop

learning.current_implemented_cost: TokenCost; legacy proxy experiment only under this new primary direction
learning.candidate_total_return: quality/misuse utility gain minus a calibrated seconds-based cost, counted once
learning.missing_latency: pending, never zero or inferred directly from token count

scope_limits: No edits to old Paper-1 contracts or historical outcomes.
This records the current objective; existing runners do not automatically enforce this JSON.
Old generation_seconds is a component diagnostic, not client E2E latency.
No millisecond or dollar value is assigned to the researcher's 90/95 analogy.
